text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod failed for release v2026.03.20-rc8 — staging artifact integrity check failed (BadZipFile).
jonathan: saw chrome wheel import fail with 'zipfile.BadZipFile: File is not a zip file' during staging smoke. :grimace:
sre-elena: `gsutil ls` shows parts named part-0003, part-0001, part-0002 — compose step looks non-deterministic.
maria: could retries / parallel uploads be causing unordered parts?
devex-ania: builder uploads parts in parallel then runs `gsutil compose gs://.../part-*` which expands lexicographically; concurrent arrival makes order unpredictable.
jonathan: builder log snippet: `for p in $(ls parts/); do gsutil cp $p gs://…/rc8/$p &; done; wait; gsutil compose gs://…/rc8/part-* out` — yep.
sre-elena: that will corrupt concatenated wheel files if ordering mismatches.
deploy-bot: Stage promotion failed, action: HOLD — manual decision required.
maria: options: pin prod to rc7 (last good), recompose deterministically from parts, or full rebuild.
jonathan: rebuild ~40m, deterministic compose ~10m if we have a parts manifest.
release-czar: change window at 2026-03-22 09:00 UTC. Need decision in an hour.
devex-ania: we have build_metadata.json containing parts_order in run artifacts; I can run `gsutil compose` with explicit order and verify with `unzip -t`.
sre-elena: if metadata exists, recompose is low risk. If missing, prefer pin.
maria: jonathan — do we have the manifest?
jonathan: confirmed: build_metadata.json lists ["part-0001","part-0002","part-0003","part-0004"].
release-czar: proposal: pin prod to rc7 now, run deterministic compose + staging smoke; if verified, manual promote rc8 outside change window only if urgent.
sre-elena: +1. maria: +1. jonathan: +1 — I'll run smoke after compose.
deploy-bot: Executing pin: prod -> v2026.03.20-rc7 (override by @release-czar).
devex-ania: running compose: `gsutil compose gs://.../rc8/part-0001 gs://.../rc8/part-0002 ... gs://.../rc8/wheel-rc8-composed.tar.gz` then `unzip -t`.
devex-ania: compose done, `unzip -t` OK. Uploaded composed artifact to staging copy.
jonathan: staging smoke run: import + basic server checks passed.
release-czar: decision recorded: pin to rc7, plan deterministic compose and a follow-up PR to emit manifest. Add release-note entry for hotfix and ARTIFACT-452.
sre-elena: filed ARTIFACT-452: "Emit deterministic manifest for chunked uploads; composer helper" assigned to devex-ania.
devex-ania: ack, will PR manifest writer and composer helper.
maria: added placeholder to internal release-notes: "ARTIFACT-452" and linked logs: https://internal.redwood/builds/5832/logs.
deploy-bot: Pin complete. prod now points to v2026.03.20-rc7. Thread closed by manual decision at 3412349401.
